title: SYSTEM TEST REPORT DOCUMENT
environment:
1. TrustCabinet test server (Staging build of app) or local build of the same commit. Round 1 (23/11/2026): app commit 6baba24f, by hand on the app server and by the QA runner on a local build; changed on app since: room mic takes of 30 minutes (ADR-0080), transcription progress bar (#504)
2. Database: PostgreSQL 17
3. LiveKit server, speech worker, local language model for the AI steps
4. Google Chrome (latest) and Microsoft Edge on desktop; Chrome on an Android phone (390px)
5. Mailbox the tester can read for invitation and notification emails

changes.description: Create System Test file from the business flows BF-01 to BF-04

Review PR 507: add password reset (UC-07) and correction of issued minutes (UC-83); correct WF04 TC01, TC04, TC05, WF06 TC02, WF07 TC02 to match the app; short Note, detail in a hidden AI context column

workflows.name: System Access and Administration
workflows.description: Administrator creates an account and assigns a role; the user signs in by password or Google and sees exactly the functions the role grants; role changes and deactivation take effect; the administrator sends a password reset link and the user sets a new password.
workflows.precondition: Administrator account; a new email address the tester controls; Google account for the Google sign-in step

workflows.name: Meeting Preparation and Approval
workflows.description: Organizer creates a meeting, prepares participants, agenda and documents, submits it; the approver rejects, the organizer revises and resubmits, the approver approves, the organizer publishes and participants receive the invitation.
workflows.precondition: Organizer (Member role), Approver (Approver role) and two Member accounts; one external guest email

workflows.name: Meeting Execution and Decision Making
workflows.description: Chair starts the published meeting, the secretary records attendance, each agenda item is discussed, a vote is opened, cast, closed and tallied, the conclusion is recorded and the chair ends the meeting.
workflows.precondition: Published meeting from WF-02 with a chair, a secretary and at least three members; an agenda of two items; a vote draft on item 1
groups: Open Vote and Confirm Documents Read

workflows.name: Post-Meeting Processing and Formal Minutes
workflows.description: Secretary uploads the audio, the system transcribes it, the secretary edits the transcript, AI drafts the summary and the minutes, the secretary submits, the chair returns them, the secretary corrects and resubmits, the chair approves and the minutes are issued, locked and readable by permission, then corrected by an issued correction.
workflows.precondition: Ended meeting from WF-03 with a chair and a secretary; an audio file of the meeting; speech worker and local language model running

workflows.name: Online Meeting Room
workflows.description: Participants and a guest join the online room of an Online/Hybrid meeting, a member raises a hand and the chair invites them to speak, the room is recorded and the recording reaches the Recording tab.
workflows.precondition: Published Online meeting in progress; chair, secretary, two members on separate browsers; guest link; LiveKit running; microphone and camera allowed

workflows.name: Voice ID
workflows.description: A user consents to Voice ID, an administrator with Voice Collector collects a voice sample on their behalf after asking each time, the transcript attributes speech to the right person, and withdrawing consent deletes the samples.
workflows.precondition: Administrator with Voice Collector capability; two members; audio of the two members speaking

workflows.name: Changes Outside the Main Flow
workflows.description: After publication the organizer reschedules the meeting, the chair hands the chair over, and the organizer cancels another meeting; notifications, calendar and email follow every change.
workflows.precondition: Two Published meetings with participants; tester can read the participants' mailboxes

workflows.name: Documents Across the Meeting
workflows.description: A user uploads to the personal library, attaches the file to a meeting, participants comment, and sensitivity limits who can see the file.
workflows.precondition: Organizer and two members; a PDF and a DOCX file; one Confidential meeting

workflows.name: Notifications and Calendar
workflows.description: Every event of WF-02 to WF-04 reaches the right people in real time on the bell and by email, and the calendar shows each meeting with its current status.
workflows.precondition: Run alongside WF-02 to WF-04 with two browsers open on different users

workflows.name: Data Isolation Across Roles
workflows.description: An outsider, a participant, the approver, the administrator and a guest each open the lists and the URLs of meetings, documents and minutes they are not part of; lists show only permitted rows and direct URLs answer 404.
workflows.precondition: Meetings in every status owned by other users; one user in none of them; a guest of another meeting
